To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Tension and Effor Stress Inventory is a valid instrument for assessing emotional changes in response to an exciting and frightening activity (2) participation in a frightening leisure activity is associated with emotional enhancement.

(1) participation in a frightening leisure activity can improve one's mood and emotional state; (2) this is associated with a change from a negative to a positive metamotivational state; and (3) this is associated also with a reduction in anxiety.

the experience of a thrilling activity (Fantasticable) can induce a reversal of metamotivation and a decrease of unpleasant emotions, which are associated with a significant increase of pleasant emotions and excitement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between arousal, excitement, and anxiety.
the effects of participation in a thrilling activity on the emotional state of the participants.
the relationship between anxiety and excitement in a context of arousal-seeking leisure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
people perform frightening activities in order to induce high arousal and to experience a reversal from negative to positive arousal.

participation in a frightening leisure activity is a way of enhancing one's emotional state, provided that the individual has the necessary psychological characteristics to experience the activity as thrilling.
the Fantasticable experience was perceived by the participants as a highly enjoyable one, and that the participants' metamotivational state was reversed from negative to positive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reversal theory model is a useful framework for explaining the motivation of people to participate in frightening activities.
the experience of a frightening activity is not necessarily a negative experience, but may be a positive experience for those who seek it.
the Fantasticable ride was a positive experience for the riders, and that the reversal theory framework is useful in explaining the psychological effects of such an activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
people may seek out thrilling activities to improve their mood.
participation in frightening activities can be a way to induce positive emotions.
people are motivated to seek out activities that induce a high degree of anxiety.
